mapper.sql: bool_delete_enum , create_time, update_time, version, id, area_id, ask_complete_time , issue_status, product_id, quantity, status, user_id , lay_way_config_id
mapper.select:
SELECT scheduling.id, scheduling.order_number, scheduling.quantity, DATE(scheduling.create_time) date, scheduling.thick, scheduling.material, scheduling.total_net_weight, scheduling.issue_status_enum, scheduling.user_id, u.name AS userName, scheduling.nesting_time, scheduling.cut_config_id, scheduling.bool_nest_cut_enum, cut.name AS cutConfigName FROM mes_building_machine_part_scheduling scheduling LEFT JOIN sys_user u on u.id = scheduling.user_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_cut_config cut on cut.id = scheduling.cut_config_id WHERE scheduling.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND DATE_FORMAT(scheduling.create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(#{dateTime}, '%Y-%m')
AND scheduling.issue_status_enum & #{issueStatusEnum} > 0
ORDER BY scheduling.issue_status_enum ASC, scheduling.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_building_machine_part_scheduling WHERE date( create_time )= date(#{now})

SELECT DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT( ask_complete_time, '%Y-%m' ) FROM mes_building_task_need_machine_part_scheduling WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 AND need_quantity > scheduling_quantity
AND workshop_id = #{workshopId}
